Scale: the plate is about 345 px across in the image. If it is a roughly 24 cm dinner plate, that is about 14 px per cm.

Pizza slice: about 120 px by 190 px, which is roughly 8.5 cm by 13 cm. Its thickness is about 1.2 cm. That gives a volume of around 130 cm³. Pizza is airy, so I took about 0.6 g/cm³, which is roughly 80 g. A rectangular focaccia-style cheese slice might be somewhat denser, so I settled on about 95 g.

Cookie: about 100 px across, or roughly 7 cm. Its height is about 1.2 cm. A cookie that size weighs about 45 g.
